title: National Pension System (NPS) Section 80CCD(1B) Tax Savings
source: PFRDA, Income Tax Act 1961 & Income Tax Act 2025
reference: Section 80CCD(1B) & Section 80CCD(2), Income Tax Act 1961 — recodified under Income Tax Act 2025
content: NPS provides dual tax saving advantages under Tax Year 2026-27: 1. Section 80C (Section 123): Contributions up to ₹1.5 Lakhs qualify within overall 80C cap. 2. Section 80CCD(1B): Exclusive additional tax deduction up to ₹50,000 above the ₹1.5L 80C limit, reducing taxable income directly. Employer NPS contributions under Section 80CCD(2) up to 14% (Central Govt) or 10% (Private Sector) of basic salary are also tax-deductible under both Old and New Tax Regimes (Section 115BAC / Section 202).
